bounded live BioContainers lookup. Use a bare tagged reference without
`docker://` or a digest.

```yaml
class: GalaxyUserTool
id: analysis-v1
name: Analysis
version: 0.1.0
container: quay.io/biocontainers/<package>:<pinned-tag>

shell_command: |
  set -eu
  selected-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:
  - name: result
    type: data
    format: tabular
    from_work_dir: result.tsv
```

python job.py "$(inputs.inpu

script = r'''
import inspect
import sys
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats
import gseapy as gp

counts_path, map_path, layout_path = sys.argv[1:4]
answer_path = \"p53_odds_ratio.txt\"
audit_path = \"audit.tsv\"

related_groups = [
    \"DMSO\",
    \"DMSO_Serum_starvation\",
    \"Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50\",
    \"Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50_Serum_starvation_16h\",
]
target_group = \"Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50\"
ref_group = \"DMSO\"
target_term = \"TP53 Regulates Transcription Of Cell Cycle Genes R-HSA-6791312\"

def norm_sample(s):
    return str(s).replace(\"-\", \"_\")

def norm_term(s):
    return \"\".join(c.lower() for c in str(s) if c.isalnum())

counts_all = pd.read_csv(counts_path, index_col=0)
counts_all.index = counts_all.index.astype(str)
counts_all.columns = [str(c) for c in counts_all.columns]
counts_all = counts_all.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors=\"raise\").astype(int)

prefilter_mask = (counts_all > 10).any(axis=1)
counts_prefiltered = counts_all.loc[prefilter_mask]

layout = pd.read_csv(layout_path)
layout[\"counts_sample\"] = layout[\"SampleID\"].map(norm_sample)
layout_rel = layout[layout[\"Group\"].isin(related_groups)].copy()
if set(layout_rel[\"Group\"]) "'!= set(related_groups):
    raise ValueError(f"Missing related groups: {set(related_groups) - set(layout_rel['"'Group'])}\")

selected_samples = layout_rel[\"counts_sample\"].tolist()
missing = [s for s in selected_samples if s not in counts_prefiltered.columns]
if missing:
    raise ValueError(f\"Count matrix missing samples: {missing}\")

counts_fit = counts_prefiltered[selected_samples].copy()
# These genes have baseMean 0 in the fitted samples and cannot pass baseMean >= 10.
counts_fit = counts_fit.loc[counts_fit.sum(axis=1) > 0]
metadata = layout_rel.set_index(\"counts_sample\")[[\"Group\"]].loc[selected_samples].copy()
metadata[\"Group\"] = pd.Categorical(metadata[\"Group\"], categories=related_groups)

counts_for_dds = counts_fit.T.astype(int)
n_cpus = max(1, int(__import__(\"os\").environ.get(\"GALAXY_SLOTS\", \"1\")))

dds_sig = inspect.signature(DeseqDataSet)
dds_kwargs = {
    \"counts\": counts_for_dds,
    \"metadata\": metadata,
    \"refit_cooks\": True,
    \"n_cpus\": n_cpus,
}
if \"design\" in dds_sig.parameters:
    dds_kwargs[\"design\"] = \"~Group\"
elif \"design_factors\" in dds_sig.parameters:
    dds_kwargs[\"design_factors\"] = \"Group\"
if \"ref_level\" in dds_sig.parameters:
    dds_kwargs[\"ref_level\"] = [\"Group\", ref_group]

dds = DeseqDataSet(**dds_kwargs)
dds.deseq2()

stat_sig = inspect.signature(DeseqStats)
stat_kwargs = {
    \"dds\": dds,
    \"contrast\": [\"Group\", target_group, ref_group],
    \"alpha\": 0.05,
}
if \"n_cpus\" in stat_sig.parameters:
    stat_kwargs[\"n_cpus\"] = n_cpus
stat_res = DeseqStats(**stat_kwargs)
stat_res.summary()
res = stat_res.results_df.copy()

required = {\"baseMean\", \"log2FoldChange\", \"padj\"}
missing_cols = required - set(res.columns)
if missing_cols:
    raise ValueError(f\"pyDESeq2 result missing columns: {missing_cols}; got {list(res.columns)}\")

sig = res[(res[\"padj\"].notna()) & (res[\"padj\"] <= 0.05) & (res[\"log2FoldChange\"].abs() >= 0.5) & (res[\"baseMean\"] >= 10)].copy()

mapping = pd.read_csv(map_path, sep=\"\\t\", dtype=str)
mapping = mapping.dropna(subset=[\"ENSG\", \"gene_name\"])
mapping = mapping[mapping[\"gene_name\"].astype(str).str.len() > 0]
ensg_to_symbol = dict(zip(mapping[\"ENSG\"].astype(str), mapping[\"gene_name\"].astype(str)))
foreground = []
unmapped = 0
for ensg in sig.index.astype(str):
    symbol = ensg_to_symbol.get(ensg)
    if symbol:
        foreground.append(symbol)
    else:
        unmapped += 1
foreground = sorted(set(foreground))
if not foreground:
    raise ValueError(\"No mapped DE genes for enrichment\")

enr = gp.enrichr(
    gene_list=foreground,
    gene_sets=\"Reactome_2022\",
    organism=\"Human\",
    outdir=None,
    cutoff=1.0,
    no_plot=True,
)
enrich = enr.results.copy()
if enrich.empty:
    raise ValueError(\"GSEApy returned no Reactome_2022 enrichment rows\")

term_norm = norm_term(target_term)
rows = enrich[enrich[\"Term\"].map(norm_term) == term_norm]
if rows.empty:
    rows = enrich[enrich[\"Term\"].astype(str).str.contains(\"TP53 Regulates Transcription Of Cell Cycle Genes\", case=False, regex=False)]
if rows.empty:
    sample_terms = enrich[enrich[\"Term\"].astype(str).str.contains(\"TP53|p53|Cell Cycle\", case=False, regex=True)][\"Term\"].head(50).tolist()
    raise ValueError(f\"Target term absent from enrichment results. Candidate terms: {sample_terms}\")
if len(rows) "'!= 1:
    raise ValueError(f"Target term matched {len(rows)} rows")
row = rows.iloc[0]
if "Odds Ratio" not in row.index:
    raise ValueError(f"No Odds Ratio column in GSEApy results: {list(enrich.columns)}")
odds = float(row["Odds Ratio"])

with open(answer_path, "w") as out:
    out.write(format(odds, ".15g") + "'"\\n\")

with open(audit_path, \"w\") as out:
    out.write(\"metric\\tvalue\\n\")
    out.write(f\"counts_all_genes\\t{counts_all.shape[0]}\\n\")
    out.write(f\"counts_all_samples\\t{counts_all.shape[1]}\\n\")
    out.write(f\"prefiltered_genes_count_gt_10_any_30\\t{counts_prefiltered.shape[0]}\\n\")
    out.write(f\"fit_samples\\t{len(selected_samples)}\\n\")
    out.write(f\"fit_genes_nonzero_related_groups\\t{counts_fit.shape[0]}\\n\")
    out.write(f\"de_genes_after_thresholds\\t{sig.shape[0]}\\n\")
    out.write(f\"mapped_foreground_unique_symbols\\t{len(foreground)}\\n\")
    out.write(f\"unmapped_de_genes\\t{unmapped}\\n\")
    out.write(f\"enrichr_rows\\t{enrich.shape[0]}\\n\")
    out.write(f\"target_term\\t{row['Term']}\\n\")
    out.write(f\"odds_ratio\\t{format(odds, '.15g')}\\n\")
    for col in [\"Overlap\", \"P-value\", \"Adjusted P-value\", \"Combined Score\", \"Genes\"]:
        if col in row.index:
            out.write(f\"target_{col}\\t{row[col]}\\n\")
'''
print(base64.b64encode(script.encode()).decode())
PY"
